record: Lithuanian Register of Cultural Property, church 22329, 2017 survey
facts: The west sandstone front has a concave center, paired three-stage bell towers, four clock faces, a sculptural crest and entry stairs. The nave is covered by a hexagonal dome with a lantern. The eastern two-story gallery and southeast sacristy turret are integral to the church.
The 1712 church has a symmetric concave facade with the Pac heraldic lily and a hexagonal cupola and lantern at 50 m.
Successive structures are symmetrically aligned along the principal entry axis. The church occupies the middle of the ensemble between the western approach and the hermitage enclosure.
